movie.title: Bunker
movie.overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife begins to question their marriage after 17 years together.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An architect's decision to design a subterranean survivalist shelter for an enigmatic tech billionaire drives a wedge through his seventeen-year marriage.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After seventeen years of marriage, an accomplished architect accepts a lucrative yet ethically dubious commission from an eccentric tech billionaire to build an ultra-exclusive survivalist bunker. As the grand underground project progresses, the client's paranoiac demands push the architect into complex moral compromises. Observing her husband's transforming values and growing secretiveness, his wife begins to deeply question their shared history and future. The intense professional endeavor quickly escalates into a psychological pressure cooker that threatens to destroy their union.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: A seasoned architect reaches a critical juncture in his career when he is offered a high-stakes, secret contract by a shadowy tech billionaire. The assignment involves constructing a state-of-the-art survivalist bunker designed to withstand apocalyptic collapse, complete with extreme security systems and lavish amenities. Enticed by financial gain and professional notoriety, the architect throws himself into the project, ignoring the disturbing ethical implications of serving elite paranoia. As he bends to the billionaire's increasingly secretive and obsessive demands, his behavior at home changes dramatically. His wife of seventeen years notices a profound shift in his moral compass, transparency, and loyalty. Distrust begins to fester in their household, prompting her to reexamine their long marriage and the ideological differences they can no longer ignore. The high-stress construction environment mirrors the couple's crumbling emotional stability, drawing all parties into a web of isolation and psychological tension. Ultimately, the process of engineering a fortress for end-times forces both spouses to confront whether their own relationship can survive the shifting foundations of their lives.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Bunker follows a veteran architect whose life is upended when he lands a massive, confidential contract to design an elite survivalist compound for a high-profile tech mogul. While the project promises financial security and unrivaled prestige, the client's secretive directives and apocalyptic worldview begin to erode the architect's moral boundaries. Back home, his wife of seventeen years watches as the husband she thought she knew becomes absorbed by secrecy and questionable ethics. As work on the subterranean fortress intensifies, the mounting friction between professional ambition and personal values forces the couple to reexamine their shared past, pushing their long marriage to a tipping point.

story_structure.climax: A critical confrontation forces both spouses to confront the true cost of their lifestyle and choose between compromised security and personal integrity.
story_structure.conflict: The architect's wife begins questioning the morality of the project and the core values of their relationship, creating a growing ideological divide between them.
story_structure.resolution: The narrative closes on the structural aftermath of their decisions, outlining the shifted dynamic of their 17-year marriage and the final reality of the completed bunker project.
story_structure.introduction: An architect with a stable 17-year marriage accepts a lucrative commission to design a high-end survivalist bunker for an elite tech billionaire.
story_structure.risingAction: As the architect becomes increasingly absorbed by the billionaire's demands and secretive vision, ethical lines blur and domestic tension escalates into severe marital strain.
